outcome: Unsloth dep tree is CUDA-targeted; pip resolution fails on this Windows + ROCm + Python 3.12 environment

evidence.failure: RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded in pip resolvelib._has_route_to_root (982 frames)
root_cause: xformers wheel resolved by pip is xformers-0.0.35-py39-none-win_amd64.whl (Python 3.9 only) — current interpreter is Python 3.12
triton-windows wheel is CUDA-only (no ROCm variant)
Compounded: resolver thrashes over xformers ↔ torch version constraints under ROCm wheel set

fallback_path.speed_penalty_vs_unsloth: ~2x slower est. (Unsloth marketing claim) — acceptable for gemma3:4b LoRA

re_probe_conditions: Unsloth ships Windows ROCm wheel set (xformers / triton-windows / cut_cross_entropy / torchao with HIP build)
OR: dual-boot Linux on EVO-X2 — separate ADR required (out of current scope)
OR: switch ROCm venv to Python 3.9 — high regression risk for existing ComfyUI stack on this box
